meta.move: Long messages with curly quotes and a concession
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's not waste them. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in the gradebook?

I want to be fair to Owen. I compared the essay with his in-class writing from September 24: 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices throughout, no quotations. This essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line, and none of those errors.

I'm writing down September 24, Hale. A timed in-class piece against a weekend essay is two different conditions, so show me both documents, and show me what else you have. You also haven't said whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero went in.
You’re right that the checker alone proves nothing. I’m taking it off the table. I’m relying on the writing and the version history.
Okay. Then say what the version history shows, Hale: dates, times, and who has seen it. And I'm still waiting to hear whether anyone spoke to Owen before that zero went in.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, copies of the September 24 writing and the version history, and a straight answer on whether anyone spoke to Owen before the mark was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position, with the zero still standing and nothing agreed.
What moved her: "I compared the essay with his in-class writing from September 24", because it was dated and tied to Owen's own work, so she wrote it down, though she hadn't yet seen the documents.
What cost ground: Nothing.
Try next time: Answer her first question about whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero in your first reply, and then bring out the September 24 writing and the version history so she can read them herself.
